description: Public Evolc profile of one company by its Evolc slug or its website domain: description, industry, size, founded year, open jobs, highlights with evidence, filed financials (newest first), public-sector customers and suppliers from the SK/CZ contract registers, and sources. No people or contact details.

domain.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. "acme.sk".

slug.description: Evolc company slug, e.g. "acme" from companies.evolc.com/company/acme.

name: get_company
title: Get a company profile
